content.short: Zengo is a multichain self-custodial wallet that uses Multi-Party Computation (MPC) for security.
content.description: Zengo is a multichain MPC wallet launched in 2018 by Ouriel Ohayon. It supports 70+ crypto assets and can connect to thousands of NFT and DeFi apps. The project has raised about $24M in venture funding, including a Series A in April 2021 that brought in $20M from investors such as Insight Partners and FJ Labs. Zengo prioritizes security by using two independently created secret shares to avoid a single point of failure and implements three-factor authentication (3FA) with a 3D biometric face scan, an email account, or a recovery kit to restore access if a device is lost or stolen.
